connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout
connectionTimeout.description: We couldn't reach the Musclog servers. Please check your internet connection.

errors.aiCreditsError: AI service quota exceeded. Please check your API key or try again later.
errors.aiProcessingError: Sorry, I had trouble processing that request. Please try again in a moment.
errors.gatewayDailyLimitError: The free AI tier is unavailable right now (its daily limit, shared by all users, may be used up). Try again later or add your own API key in AI Settings.

databaseError.title: Database error
databaseError.description: A database error occurred. Error reporting has been enabled to help resolve this issue.

errors.aiInvalidApiKey: Your {{provider}} API key was rejected. Check it in AI settings.
errors.aiTimeout: This is taking too long. Try again.
errors.onDeviceNotReady: On-device AI isn't ready yet. Finish setting it up in AI settings, or choose another AI.
errors.onDevicePhotosNotInstalled: In AI settings, reinstall the model with photo understanding enabled to use meal photos offline.
errors.onDevicePhotosUnsupported: Apple Intelligence can’t analyze meal photos here. Choose a model that supports photos in AI settings.
errors.onDeviceLoadFailed: On-device AI couldn't start, usually because the phone is low on memory. Close other apps and try again.
errors.aiKeyTestRejected: Key rejected. Check it and try again.
errors.aiKeyTestNetwork: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection.
errors.hostedBudget: This period's Musclog Iron allowance is used up. It renews on {{date}}. Musclog keeps working, and you can use your own key or the free tier.
errors.hostedBudgetNoDate: This period's Musclog Iron allowance is used up. Musclog keeps working, and you can use your own key or the free tier.
errors.hostedSubscription: Musclog Iron has no active subscription on this device. Restore your purchase or subscribe in Musclog Iron settings.
errors.hostedRemoved: This device was removed from your Musclog Iron subscription. Restore purchases in Musclog Iron settings to add it again.
errors.hostedUnavailable: Musclog Iron is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.hostedDailyFull: Musclog Iron is at capacity until tomorrow (UTC).
errors.hostedDailyLimit: You have reached today's Musclog Iron limit. It resets at midnight (UTC). You can use your own key or the free tier meanwhile.
errors.hostedBusy: Musclog Iron is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.hostedAlreadyProcessed: That request was already handled. Please send it again.
